title: Inspecting node with `EditorInterface` when there is no edited scene crashes editor
body:
### Tested versions

- since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113051 cc @KoBeWi (sorry for all the pings)

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2400x1350 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

- Originally found here https://github.com/Zylann/godot_editor_debugger_plugin/issues/18 

Calling `EditorInterface.inspect_object` with a node in the editor crashes when there is no edited scene.

In `SceneTreeEditor::_get_node_path`, `get_scene_node()` can be null.

SceneTreeDock or somewhere should check if the node is part of the edited scene or if there is no edited scene.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add a new scene, don't create any nodes in it.
2. Run this line in an EditorScript or plugin:
```gdscript
	EditorInterface.inspect_object(EditorInterface.get_base_control())
```
3. Crash.

Also happens when inspecting other nodes.

Or use a plugin like EditorDebugger that can inspect nodes.
